name: cobol-exec-host-var-indicator-adjacency
body: host_vars treats a colon whose byte offset touches the end of the previous host variable as an indicator, so :HV:IND records only HV; SPEC names no indicator rule, so this is the conservative reading. Limit: a spaced indicator (:HV :IND) records IND as a bogus reference, and COPY REPLACING that rewrites the text can break the adjacency. Upgrade when an IBM source (SPEC O27) shows spaced indicators or a rule keyed on the INDICATOR keyword.
